statements.status_notes: This vulnerability requires ext.NativeTypes with ext.ParseStructTag to expose fields marked with a skip tag. The shipped Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 1.32 binary contains neither NativeTypes nor ParseStructTag symbols, so the vulnerable code is not linked into the image.
